title: View Single Chore History for Household

criteria.text: User Action: The user navigates to the household's chore list. Expected System Behavior: Displays the household's available chores.

User Action: The user selects a specific chore. Expected System Behavior: Displays the selected chore's history, including its creation date, due dates, completion dates, completion statuses, and the housemate responsible for each completion when available.
User Action: The user reviews previous completions of the selected chore. Expected System Behavior: Displays completion records in chronological order, with the most recent record shown first.
Error Condition: The user attempts to view a chore from a household they do not belong to. Expected message: “You are not apart of this household.”
Error Condition: The user has no chore history. Expected message: “No chore history.”
Error Condition: The chore history fails to load. Expected System Behavior: Displays an error message and provides an option to retry loading the history.
Error Condition: A chore has been deleted or is no longer available. Expected message: “Chore no longer available.”
